sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — All 55 Trophies
GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies & Achievements
GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements: Full List of 55 and Platinum

roadmap.title: Play the story, save every chapter
roadmap.text: Run the five chapters in order and keep a manual save at the start of each one — there is no mission replay and no New Game+. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends.

roadmap.title: Open the partner tools
roadmap.text: Character switching opens in Chapter 2. From there you can call your partner in, scan with WAiNK, build Focus and try the activities as they appear.

roadmap.title: Finish the character questlines
roadmap.text: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each end in a trophy. Start each chain the moment it appears; all of them stay open after the credits.

roadmap.title: Work the robberies
roadmap.text: Chapter 3 opens jewelry stores with the Snap Gun; Chapter 4 opens bank vaults. Chain three shops with your partner, rob five vaults, hit one gang operation per gang.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks
roadmap.text: Eight qualifying stranger strands earn the Silver. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the character questlines do not. Do Yago's timed race the moment it shows up.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist
roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and clear it: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 card sets, all 8 vaults and all 39 gang operations.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and platinum
roadmap.text: Sweep the last meditations, the unconfirmed one-offs and any misc trophies left, then watch Vice Got a Price! pop.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum lands the moment the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut: one playthrough, no online trophies, and the 100% checklist is the long pole.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one pops on its own.
The official description reads 'Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.'
Plan on about 200 hours — the guides agree on that except Push Square, which says 300 or more.
One playthrough is enough; free roam stays open after the credits.
No trophy needs online play or a difficulty setting.
Keep cheats off your trophy save — they switch trophies and saving off.
Save before the final mission; there is no mission replay.

disputes.q: How long does the Platinum take?
disputes.a: About 200 hours — PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, EGamers, OutputLag, GTA Zone and GTAScoop all put it there.
disputes.b: Up to 300 hours or more — Push Square's guide opens with that figure.
disputes.call: Plan for 200, budget 300. The checklist is the long pole either way, so the gap is pacing, not content.

disputes.q: How long does a cheat block trophies?
disputes.a: Cheats disable trophies and saving — PowerPyx and KeenGamer state it flatly.
disputes.b: The block lasts for the current session, the way it did in GTA 5 and RDR2 — GTABase.
disputes.call: Treat it as session-scoped, but never test it on your main save. Keep a clean save and cheat only on a throwaway one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, hands you this on your first play session.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing as Jason.
It is the first mission of Chapter 1 and cannot be missed.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
No special condition — just finish it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy arrives as Chapter 2 begins.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 1's missions in order.
The trophy pops once you play the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 — there is no replay.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation before this chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy lands as Chapter 3 opens.

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2 to its end.
It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
Character switching opens during this chapter — see the note on Hot Together.
Billy's questline opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break.

disputes.q: How is this trophy's name spelled?
disputes.a: Most lists mask it as T**s Ass Drug Money.
disputes.b: GamesFuze prints it unmasked as Tits Ass Drug Money; GTAScoop writes T*ts.
disputes.call: The official list masks it. We use the masked form the starter list and most guides use.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 3's missions.
It arrives after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions of Chapter 4.
Andy's Lucia-only questline and the Snap Gun both open in this chapter.
Randy's wish list opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4; the final mission of the chapter is Starting From Zero.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4 through to its final mission, Starting From Zero.
The bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is… is optional and opens in this chapter.
Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown all sit in this chapter.
Keep a save from just before the final mission.

disputes.q: Is it Top Of or Top of?
disputes.a: Top Of The World, Ma — PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, EGamers, Insider Gaming, OutputLag, GTA Zone and GamesFuze.
disputes.b: Top of the World, Ma — Push Square and GTAScoop print it lowercase.
disputes.call: The official list spells it Top Of The World, Ma. We use that.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Which mission that is, the guides argue about — see the dispute.

steps.t: Play the story to its final mission and finish it.
The official description reads 'Complete the final mission.'
PowerPyx says the final mission follows Starting From Zero; GTABase names Operation Savage Glory.
Insider Gaming words the same trophy as Complete Chapter 5.
Free roam carries on after the credits, so cleanup can wait.
Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission.
This is the hidden Gold — the other Gold is A Long Road.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: it unlocks after Starting From Zero, the final mission of Chapter 4.
disputes.b: GTABase and GTA Zone: Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Insider Gaming words the trophy as Complete Chapter 5.
disputes.call: Play through Chapter 5. The gold pops at the credits either way — do not stop at Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

steps.t: Play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
It is a story mission and cannot be missed.
OutputLag ties character switching to this mission; other guides tie it to Coffee Break.
No extra condition — finishing the mission is enough.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

steps.t: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Story mission, unmissable.
It sits in the same chapter as Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs and the Snap Gun.
Finish it before moving on to Chapter 4's vaults.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4.

steps.t: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Story mission, unmissable.
Chapter 4 also holds Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
Nothing here affects the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4.

steps.t: Play Headliners in Chapter 4.
Story mission, unmissable.
It is one of three Chapter 4 mission trophies, with Child's Play and VCIA Takedown.
No side condition — the mission alone pops it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 — the airport mission that also teaches you the airfield.

steps.t: Play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Story mission, unmissable.
The airport you storm here is where Catch Me If You Can happens later.
Finish it, then keep the save — the finale is close.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory — the Chapter 5 mission the finale dispute turns on.

steps.t: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
GTABase and GTA Zone place this mission in Chapter 5.
Story mission, unmissable.
If PowerPyx is right that the finale sits in Chapter 4, this still pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The hardest trophy and the longest grind — the checklist opens after the story and asks for shares, not everything.

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits.
The official description is simply 'Attain 100% Completion.'
Work done before the credits already counts — nothing on the list is missable.
Complete all robberies: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults.
Finish 100 optional missions; there are more than 100, so missing a few is safe.
Land 300 stunts of the 397 — the trophy only needs 250.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges; the trophy needs 50.
Scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with WAiNK.
Study 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars.
Complete 15 of the 18 collectible card sets.
Meditate at 15 of the 18 spots; the trophy itself wants all 18.
Earn all 42 Shooting Range golds and win all 42 drone races.
Finish all 15 of Bret's Target Decks and the 33 underwater discoveries.

disputes.a: A Long Road alone — PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer all rank it hardest.
disputes.b: A Long Road and The Shootist together — GamesFuze names both as hardest.
disputes.call: A Long Road is the time sink; The Shootist is the skill check. Budget time for both.

disputes.q: How much of the game does 100% ask for?
disputes.a: Roughly 60% of true completion — PowerPyx, quoted by EGamers and GTA Zone.
disputes.b: Almost everything — Push Square says you do have to do almost everything.
disputes.call: 60% is right. The checklist asks for shares (200 of 277, 100 of 255, 15 of 18), not everything.

disputes.q: Can anything on the checklist be missed?
disputes.a: Nothing on it is missable — GTABase.
disputes.b: Some optional missions are only offered for a while — KeenGamer, and GTABase says the same.
disputes.call: No checklist item is missable, because there are more than 100 optional tasks and only 100 are needed. Missing a few costs nothing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of the 397 across Leonida. Under-bridge flights are the fastest way up.

steps.t: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix.
The split is 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up.
The optional challenge on each stunt is not needed for the count.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
The map can show every stunt spot.
The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
Stunt jumps carry extra challenges that do not need clearing for this trophy.
Base jumps drop through checkpoints before the parachute opens.
Knife flights thread narrow gaps between tall buildings around Vice City.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Most of them happen on their own while you play.

steps.t: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade, a race win and a stunt.
Fish once — Cal's challenge in Chapter 1 covers it.
Hunt once with Bret's questline after Chapter 2.
Play a round of golf when you find a course.
Enter any shooting range and finish one challenge.
Play a frame of pool at a bar table.
Sink one basket at a basketball hoop.
Finish any one arcade game on the home TV or a cabinet.
Win any car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race.
Land any stunt — one jump is enough. Progress > Activities shows what is left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 golds. The guides disagree on how many ranges hold them.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds.
PowerPyx and GTABase count 12 shooting ranges; OutputLag and Push Square count two.
The two named ranges are Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero.
Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold.
Some challenges stay locked until you meet other conditions — check the map.
Track progress under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.
The 100% checklist needs all 42 golds as well, so there is no shortcut.
GamesFuze ranks this joint-hardest with A Long Road.

disputes.q: How many shooting ranges are there?
disputes.a: 12 ranges with 42 gold medals between them — PowerPyx and GTABase.
disputes.b: Two ranges with 42 gold medals between them — OutputLag and Push Square, naming Rodgers Ranch and Griffin.
disputes.call: Trust the 42 golds, not the range count. Check Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges in-game and clear what it lists.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 spots, one win each.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
One win per location is enough for the trophy.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each spot while you are there.
Some locations charge an entry fee.
Find locations under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
Drone races count as the race win for Master of None too.
42 races across 14 locations — three per spot.
All 42 drone time trials count toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count.

steps.t: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from.
Winning the same race again does not count.
Track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
Most race spots let you hire a car — watch its rating.
Car mods from Mod Shops raise your car's rating.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 won.
You meet race spots naturally while exploring Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The challenge is a parrotfish over 2kg — or so one guide says.

steps.t: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Cal texts you after that and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon.
Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.
Push Square names the catch: a Parrotfish over 2kg.
Fish in the marked area until a suitably sized fish bites.
You need a boat with a fishing rod — hijack one nearby if you have none.
This also counts as the fishing activity for Master of None.
Each fish you land also feeds your Focus meter.

disputes.a: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge — PowerPyx and GTABase describe the quest.
disputes.b: Catch a Parrotfish over 2kg — Push Square names the fish.
disputes.call: Same job. The challenge is the parrotfish catch: fish the marked spot until one over 2kg lands.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any one of the four in-game games, all levels, once.

steps.t: Complete any one arcade game — reach the end of it at least once.
There are 4 games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
The first three play on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers.
Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world.
You do not need to beat every challenge — just reach the end.
You can already play the home games during Chapter 1.
The home TV is briefly unavailable in some story sections, then works again.
This covers the arcade activity for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — a Lucia-only chain of five quests in Chapter 3.

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3; Andy calls, then texts her an address in Belville.
The chain is Lucia-only.
Do the five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
The last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy.
All quests stay available after the story.
This chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Andy is one of six character questlines with its own trophy.
Start it the moment it is marked — do not leave it for cleanup.
Track it under the quest markers on the map in Belville.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — dive seven shipwrecks for treasure.

steps.t: Meet Kenton in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton); he marks himself with the green KR icon in Key Lento.
He marks purple treasure chest icons on the map for shipwrecks.
Dive at the markers and use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor.
Bring the treasure back to Kenton; he marks more spots after each set.
Clear 7 shipwrecks in total for his questline.
Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees or Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapter 2-3 — he is not missable.
Calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds his return text up.
Push Square names his final mission Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — five jobs from the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

steps.t: Billy's chain opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Do the five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.
The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy.
The Impaler asks you to steal the Impaler.
All his quests stay available after the story.
This chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Billy is one of six character questlines with its own trophy.
Start it when it is marked — the mud club sits in Kelly County.
Three of the five are jobs you join Billy on; one is stealing the Impaler.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only some questlines count — the character finales do not.

steps.t: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands across Leonida.
Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count — their strands are confirmed.
Kirk: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Kyle: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?
Yago: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother.
Pilot Pete: The Last Mile, Backseat Pilot and his delivery runs.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count — they have their own trophies or chains.
Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed — check the counter.
All strands stay available after the story in free roam.

disputes.a: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not — PowerPyx and GTABase.
disputes.b: GamesFuze calls Andy's and Billy's finales stranger missions, and GTAScoop says the strands count toward 100% Completion too — GTABase says stranger missions are not part of 100%.
disputes.call: Count only the four confirmed strands and watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.

disputes.a: Yes — OutputLag: Yago's Chapter 3 race, Race Against Yago, carries an hourglass icon. Do it the moment it appears and save first.
disputes.b: No other guide flags any timed stranger mission.
disputes.call: Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears. It is the only timed warning in any guide, and a save costs nothing.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — deliver 16 sports cars from his wish list.

steps.t: Randy's wish list opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon).
The Zorrusso is delivered automatically during that story mission.
The list: Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D.
Scan cars with WAiNK to see if one is on the list.
Hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look.
Cars in better condition pay more.
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
He marks new locations as you complete the ones he gave you.
This can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — shut down the synthetic labs, Jason-only.

steps.t: Tyrone's chain is Jason-only and opens after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Purple markers point at Synthetic Labs around Vice City.
Go to the labs and destroy them — the quest is Take Out Kitty Litter.
After enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives his second quest and the trophy follows.
GTABase names the last job Shut Down the Labs; PowerPyx calls it Spin On This.
All of it stays available after the story.
This chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Kitty Litter lab locations are listed in the guides if you get stuck.

disputes.q: What is Tyrone's final job called?
disputes.a: Spin On This — PowerPyx lists the quests as Take Out Kitty Litter, then Spin On This.
disputes.b: Shut Down the Labs — GTABase names the last job that.
disputes.call: Same finale under two names. Finish the lab chain and the trophy follows the last job, whatever it is called in your language.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots, and the Chapter 1 balcony one may be missable. Do it first.

steps.t: There are 18 Meditation Spots across 10 different locations.
The official description reads 'Meditate at every spot across Leonida.'
Meditate with Lucia and Jason at the same spot and it counts twice.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
The first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1.
After Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she walks to the balcony to meditate.
Talk to her on the balcony and choose Accept, then finish the sequence.
That balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest.
Whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save.
The last meditation needs both characters together, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
For 100% you only need 15 of 18; the trophy wants all 18.
A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played.

disputes.q: Does the trophy need the Chapter 1 balcony meditation?
disputes.a: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, EGamers and GTA Zone all say nobody has confirmed it.
disputes.b: OutputLag's short answer says the balcony meditation counts toward Positive Mental Attitude.
disputes.call: Do it in Chapter 1. It costs two minutes and removes the only known lockout risk in the whole list.

disputes.a: 18 spots for the trophy — PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase.
disputes.b: 15 for the 100% checklist — EGamers frames the two numbers as the sources disagreeing.
disputes.call: Different counters, not a conflict. The trophy wants all 18; the checklist wants 15 of 18. Do all 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — Jason-only, after Chapter 2. Which animal triggers it is still unconfirmed.

steps.t: Bret's chain starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
The chain is Jason-only; Lucia cannot receive the message.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason.
His first quest gives you the hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69.
A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.
Which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed.
The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so the trophy should come along the way.
Track the decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets of the 18. The 100% checklist wants 15.

steps.t: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them.
There are 18 card sets in total.
The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
The 100% checklist wants 15 full sets, so this pops on the way.
Cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Set locations are listed in the guides if you want a route.
Card sets are scattered across Leonida.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — any mix of landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags.

steps.t: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1).
Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
31 + 35 + 23 is 89, so No Flusher tags make up the rest — scan everything.
WAiNK is an app on Jason or Lucia's phone, opened by holding Up.
Scan vehicles with it too — that feeds Whip It Good.
The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this is done once.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
Scan whenever you pass something new — do not leave it all for cleanup.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges of the 80. The checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges.
The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.
View and track challenges under Progress > Challenges.
Finished ones show a tick in the bottom right when you scroll over them.
Many complete themselves while you play — leave this for late.
There are 10 more challenges than the checklist needs, so skip the hardest 10.
Save the challenges for later if you are struggling with them.
Pick the easiest remaining ones once the rest of the list is done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the classic route.

steps.t: Possible once both characters are together — after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, per most guides.
Call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad, then Triangle.
Get a 4-star Wanted Level — cause carnage until the fourth star lands.
It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well.
A fast sports motorcycle cuts through traffic best for the escape.
Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
PowerPyx says it also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
If a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it goes away.

disputes.a: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 — PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer.
disputes.b: Right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 — OutputLag.
disputes.call: Switching opens in Chapter 2 either way. If Breakfast Run does not unlock it, finish Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are the classic run.

steps.t: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you.
You need both characters together — after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Keep the red and blue flashing wanted level; if it fades to the red heat zone alone, the chain breaks.
The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together — use them.
They open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
Rob a couple of items in each store; break the back-room safe with sticky bombs if you can.
Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items.
The trophy takes about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
If you leave the first store before police arrive, you may need a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning is the confirmed route; getting in may count too.

steps.t: Discover 100 different vehicles.
Scan them with the WAiNK app — hold Up, then R1 on a vehicle.
Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them.
Stand at a busy road and scan passing traffic.
Push Square says getting inside a vehicle also discovers it.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops on the way.
GTA VI features 557 vehicles at launch — the checklist counts 277 base models.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles, by category.

disputes.q: Does getting in a car discover it, or only scanning?
disputes.a: Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them — PowerPyx and GTABase.
disputes.b: You discover a vehicle when you get inside one or when you scan one — Push Square.
disputes.call: Scanning is the confirmed route. Scan everything; getting in may also count, but never rely on it alone.

disputes.a: 557 vehicles at launch — PowerPyx.
disputes.b: 277 base models — every guide's checklist figure.
disputes.call: Different counters. 557 counts every variant; 277 counts base models. The trophy needs 100 discovered, the checklist 200 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus first, use an assault rifle, pick gang thugs.

steps.t: Combat Focus activates with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm.
It slows time and highlights weak spots; it only lasts a few seconds.
Fill your Focus first: eat, drink, wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer.
Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — more accurate than pistols and SMGs, full-auto.
Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can walk out of cover and get close.
Focus has 4 levels; shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it.
Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, per OutputLag.
Check your Focus level under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Focus.

disputes.q: How much Focus does a fish give?
disputes.a: About 10% per fish landed — OutputLag.
disputes.b: No number — PowerPyx and GTABase list Focus-raising activities (ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) without amounts.
disputes.call: Fish to top Focus up cheaply. The 10% figure is OutputLag's alone, so treat it as a rough guide, not a promise.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a jet docked at a boarding bridge, gates E3/E4, and fly 1km clear.

steps.t: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA.
Planes parked out on the airfield do not count — it must be at a boarding bridge.
The easiest plane is at departure terminals E3/E4.
Drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight to the plane.
Next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane.
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy is delayed until then.
You can also enter on foot through the airport terminal.
Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station and fight from inside it.

steps.t: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station.
PowerPyx and GTABase put the base on an island at the south-west edge of the map, in Mariana County.
OutputLag puts it on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys.
The tanks stand in the south of the air base.
Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.
Save first — the base is guarded and the wanted level spikes.
The description's Rhinos are the tank model — any tank at the base counts.

disputes.q: Where is Mile Zero Air Station?
disputes.a: An island at the south-west edge of the map, in Mariana County — PowerPyx and GTABase.
disputes.b: On Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys — OutputLag.
disputes.call: Both describe the same south-west island base. Follow the in-game map marker for Mile Zero Air Station, not either county name.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Snap Gun the back door, take the safe code, clear the safe — and mind the cameras.

steps.t: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 first — it gives you the Snap Gun.
Jewelry store robberies unlock with the same quest and get marked with a green icon.
Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door; kicking it in sets off the alarm.
The Snap Gun stays in your inventory — you do not need to equip it.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe.
PowerPyx adds two steps GTABase never mentions: destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave without being spotted; the trophy unlocks shortly after you leave.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
If someone spots you, reload and try again.

disputes.q: Do you need to destroy the security footage and disable the alarm?
disputes.a: Yes — PowerPyx lists both as steps in the back room.
disputes.b: GTABase's method never mentions them: Snap Gun, safe code, leave unseen.
disputes.call: Do the extra two steps. They cost seconds, and the only guide that details the back room insists on them.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults open with the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — and the grade is Silver, whatever one guide says.

steps.t: Finish the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) first.
The official description reads 'Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.'
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank; a guard carries a briefcase in and the vault opens.
Get in while the vault is open and rob it.
You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hand off a bag.
Robbing a vault gives a 4-star wanted level instantly.
Escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognized.
Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 once you have robbed 2 Payday Loans.
There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; 5 are enough here, 8 for 100%.
Each vault pays up to $205,000 — the best money in the endgame.
Seven lists call this Silver, 40G; Push Square alone lists it as Bronze.

disputes.a: Silver, 40G — GTABase, KeenGamer, EGamers, OutputLag, GamesFuze, GTA Zone and GTAScoop.
disputes.b: Bronze — Push Square's trophy table.
disputes.call: Silver. Seven lists agree; Push Square's table is the outlier.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. A bank vault job counts — or blow a truck's doors with a sticky bomb.

steps.t: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat zone.
Robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck.
Vaults open with That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 — see Maximum Withdrawal.
Earlier method: box in an armored truck driving near a bank and plant a sticky bomb on its back doors.
Blow the doors open, take the cash and get away.
The trophy only pops once you leave the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.
Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
Yasmani unlocks as a fence from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — unfog the whole map. A plane is the fastest way.

steps.t: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida.
The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.
Fly low over black fog until the whole map turns visible.
This is pure exploration — no combat or collectible is needed.
Do it after the story, when the whole map is open.
Unfogging also helps every other exploration trophy — scan and study as you fly.
The trophy pops the moment the last dark patch clears.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, nine gangs, 39 operations in total.

steps.t: Rob one illegal gang operation from each of the 9 gangs.
There are 39 Illegal Gang Operations in total.
They show as yellow icons on the map when you go near them.
Many get marked automatically from story progress.
Track them under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang to see its count.
The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way.
Gang operation thugs are also good targets for Gunslinger.
One per gang is enough here — do not clear all 39 early.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. One guide names the bar and the drink; the rest call it unconfirmed.

steps.t: Go to Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini there.
Drink it while standing next to the bar to unlock the trophy.
GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop, OutputLag and KeenGamer all list the exact steps as unconfirmed.
EGamers notes PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known — yet PowerPyx's guide text gives the bar and the drink.
Try PowerPyx's exact order first; it is the only guide that names a bar and a drink.
The description is the only hint the other guides trust: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

disputes.a: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini, drunk next to the bar — PowerPyx.
disputes.b: Exact steps unconfirmed — GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop, OutputLag and KeenGamer.
disputes.call: Try PowerPyx's exact order first. It is the only guide that names a bar and a drink; the rest only repeat the description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — one guide names the blue Banshee; the rest call it unconfirmed.

steps.t: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City.
Drive it forward straight through the showroom window.
You need the Key Cloner first, from Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops a little after you drive away on the street — it is slightly delayed.
It only unlocks from this blue Banshee, not any other car.
PowerPyx calls it an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop and OutputLag list the exact steps as unconfirmed.
The description alone points to crashing a car out through a showroom window.

disputes.a: The blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City, after the Key Cloner — PowerPyx.
disputes.b: Exact steps unconfirmed — GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop and OutputLag.
disputes.call: PowerPyx's method is the only detailed one, and the Key Cloner gate puts it in Chapter 3 at the earliest. Try it there.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — which is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. Steal all 3 key valuables.

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — OutputLag: the Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling.
It is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2.
Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe.
Take the luxury watch in the south-east office.
Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner.
Loot the safe in the office in the north-east hallway — blow it with a sticky bomb.
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item.
Killing the enemies is not necessary for the trophy.
You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery respawns after a long time, so missing one is not fatal.

disputes.a: The trophy text says Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, GTABase and GTAScoop all say Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
disputes.call: Same place. OutputLag reconciles them: the Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling. Go there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.t: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
You can only start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can switch characters.
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength.
Buy a gym membership at a fitness club and work out there.
Always go together with your partner — hold Right and press Triangle to call them.
While one character works out, the other completes their training automatically.
Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon).
After the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
View the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile.
A little demon face on the right of the screen marks each counted action.
Profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
Professional: finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes.
Most players get it without trying — every robbery and enemy encounter counts.
Do not push toward Irredeemable — it is permanent.

disputes.a: Yes — PowerPyx, GTABase, HowToVideoGame, OutputLag and GTAScoop all give 500.
disputes.b: EGamers flags it as single source.
disputes.call: 500 is well sourced. EGamers' note is out of date; five guides agree on the number.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The leading theory points at the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba — a belief, not a confirmation.

steps.t: The description reads Second time's the charm.
PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
The theory: rob that store again later, in a specific manner.
The store sits in Vice City, Little Cuba.
GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop and OutputLag all list the exact steps as unconfirmed.
Try it after the story; do not grind it early — it is a belief, not a confirmation.

disputes.a: PowerPyx's belief: the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, robbed again later in a specific manner.
disputes.b: Unconfirmed — GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop and OutputLag.
disputes.call: A belief, not a confirmation. Try it after the story; do not grind it early.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Three unconfirmed leads: a UFO, a graffiti code, or an abduction — none confirmed.

steps.t: PowerPyx: complete the UFO easter egg on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
The official description reads 'What the hell just happened?'
Go at night, after 2AM, and come solo.
A blinking car sometimes sits at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, and it drops an abducted woman — talk to her and help.
OutputLag's first lead: a stairwell room in Crosstown, east of the Pawn & Gun, fills with glowing graffiti hiding a six-digit code.
That code should open the safe on the ground floor and pop the trophy — the room may only appear once.
OutputLag's second lead: a UFO abduction side story Lucia can find in Chapter 2, tied to a keypad at the Abandoned Site.
GTABase, GTA Zone and GTAScoop list the exact steps as unconfirmed.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: a UFO easter egg at Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM, solo.
disputes.b: OutputLag: two leads — a Crosstown graffiti six-digit code safe, or a Chapter 2 UFO abduction with an Abandoned Site keypad. GTABase, GTA Zone and GTAScoop: unconfirmed.
disputes.call: Try the Starlet Motel UFO first — it is the most detailed lead. Keep the Crosstown code as backup. All of it is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. One guide says: bike, kick 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds. The rest call it unconfirmed.

steps.t: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
Do it in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
The description is a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a vehicle.
GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop and OutputLag list the exact steps as unconfirmed.
KeenGamer also lists the precise method as still being confirmed.
EGamers writes that PowerPyx marks Ten Pin as not yet known — yet PowerPyx's guide text gives the bike method.
Try PowerPyx's method at Ocean Beach; it is the only concrete one published.

disputes.q: How do you bowl them over?
disputes.a: Bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square in 60 seconds — PowerPyx.
disputes.b: Exact steps unconfirmed — GTABase, GTA Zone, GTAScoop, OutputLag and KeenGamer.
disputes.call: PowerPyx's method is the only concrete one published. Try it at crowded Ocean Beach.

disputes.q: Does PowerPyx even give a method?
disputes.a: EGamers writes that PowerPyx marks Ten Pin as not yet known.
disputes.b: PowerPyx's own guide text gives the bike-kick method in full.
disputes.call: Trust PowerPyx's own text over EGamers' summary of it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Bank vaults alone can cover it.

steps.t: Finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob Banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is a running total; you do not need it in one trip.
Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, once they unlock in Chapter 4.
The 100% checklist's robberies get you there on their own.
Marked Bills Fenced of $250,000 is also a 100% checklist line.
Yasmani's tips about security vans cost $10,000 and lead to more vaults.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way through it.

steps.t: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops.
Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest method — they cost the most.
Shop counts: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear, 18 Hair & Beauty, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics.
It is a running total across every kind of shop.
Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style.
It pops on its own while you buy gear for the other trophies.
Push Square calls it the easiest trophy in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 for sale, about $160,000. The 4 story garages do not count.

steps.t: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app.
The app unlocks after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
The 8 cost $160,000 in total.
Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600.
Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800.
The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
Push Square says all 8 have 1 parking spot; PowerPyx says each adds 1 or more.
You need the space — registering 10 vehicles for On the Spot needs free spots.
Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially in Chapters 3-4.

disputes.a: 8 to buy — PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, OutputLag and Push Square.
disputes.b: 12 in total, counting the 4 story garages — PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer.
disputes.call: Buy the 8. The 4 story garages do not count toward the trophy.

disputes.q: How many parking spots per garage?
disputes.a: All 8 have 1 parking spot — Push Square.
disputes.b: Each garage adds 1 or more parking spots — PowerPyx.
disputes.call: Plan on 1 spot each. 8 spots for 10 registrations means you also use story-garage space — buy all 8 before registering.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses takes them first; Pay 'n' Spray takes tracked ones from Chapter 3.

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray, then Register.
At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers.
From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Push Square says any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop registers a vehicle at any time, given a free spot.
Buy garages first — each garage adds parking spots for registrations.
Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
Scooter Bros then delivers your registered vehicles, fully repaired, for a small fee.
You need to register 10 different vehicles.

disputes.a: Moses in Port Gellhorn, Respray then Register; Pay 'n' Spray only for tracked cars from Chapter 3 — PowerPyx and GTABase.
disputes.b: Any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop registers a vehicle at any time, given a free spot — Push Square.
disputes.call: Use Moses first. Pay 'n' Spray works for tracked cars from Chapter 3; untracked cars go to Moses.
